title: Rate-free equidistribution of the nested floor-power tower (the qualitative K3 target)
statement: For each fixed depth d, the Juggler parity classes of length d have natural densities equal to their Bernoulli(1/2) values; equivalently (per depth) the floor-power tower ({n^{3/2}}, {v^{3/2}}, {z^{3/2}}, ...) with v = floor(n^{3/2}), z = floor(v^{3/2}) is jointly equidistributed in the limit, WITHOUT any rate. By the rate-free reduction (J-rate-free-density-one) this implies density-one finite descent; a node-wise biased form (every surviving class sends E-share >= beta > 1 - log2/log3 = 0.36907) suffices. The quantitative form (power savings, Conjecture K / Conjecture V / HH) is strictly stronger and is PARKED behind the BB/GG/JJ obstruction ladder; this record is the weakest hypothesis that still yields density one.
mathematical_domain: Juggler parity discrepancy / ergodic equidistribution of bracket-Hardy sequences
tested_range: dyadic window (10^6, 2*10^6]: 8x8x8 joint census of the depth-3 tower over 5*10^5 odd n, all 512 cells occupied, max cell deviation 0.145 of expectation vs extreme-value allowance 0.161; OOOO-conditioned fifth-letter even share 0.49835 (3-sigma band 0.0060); depth-4 split censuses of the two-step parity branch consistent through 2*10^6; nil-lift probe (dyadic (10^6, 2*10^6]): horizontal triple ((3/2)v^{3/4}, v^{3/2}, (1/2)v^{9/4}) mod 1 uniform, 124 fixed harmonics at square-root scale (max 2.11 sqrt N), Heisenberg vertical/abelian pair uniform
counterexamples: none; a persistent cell deficit in the joint census or a fifth-letter share bounded away from [0.37, 0.63] on a positive-density subtree would refute
literature: Bergelson-Leibman generalized polynomials via nilmanifolds (polynomial brackets, arbitrary depth); Frantzikinakis, Equidistribution of sparse sequences on nilmanifolds (2009, integer-part removal for Hardy functions); Richter, Uniform distribution in nilmanifolds along Hardy field functions (2022); Tsinas, Pointwise convergence in nilmanifolds along Hardy functions (2023); arXiv 2510.20562 (2025): twice-iterated Piatetski-Shapiro sequences by Kolesnik's method at SMALL amplitudes only. No published result covers nested floor-power brackets with Hardy (non-polynomial) entries: the door is unbuilt, not walled.
notes: The tower observable expands by two-term Taylor (Lemma 7.2 of Paper B) into a finite-complexity bracket-Hardy expression: {z^{3/2}} = {v^{9/4} - (3/2) v^{3/4} {v^{3/2}} + o(1)}, so the target is exactly the Hardy-field extension of the Bergelson-Leibman bracket calculus, where brackets lift to nilmanifold coordinates instead of Fourier expansions. The BB/GG/JJ obstructions formally block rated (power-savings) methods only: BB kills differencing (W-family past 9/4), GG kills character windows (amplitude drift), JJ kills shift de-randomization; none of the three names an obstruction to rate-free ergodic identification. Falsifier for the route: the floor-removal correction term (3/2) v^{3/4} {v^{3/2}} may re-enter the amplitude-product class inside any candidate characteristic-factor argument, adding a fourth (ergodic) layer to the wall. No Paper B edit; the quantitative conjectures V and HH stay recorded and PARKED as-is. Sharpened 1 Sep 2026 (J-tower-heisenberg-coordinate): the depth-3 tower phase is, up to an explicit O(n^{-9/8}) error, a coordinate of the orbit ((3/2) v^{3/4}, v^{3/2}, 0) Gamma x (1/2) v^{9/4} on H_3(R)/H_3(Z) x T - the Heisenberg lift is exact algebra and the recorded falsifier did NOT fire at the algebraic level; the conjecture reduces to rate-free equidistribution of this floor-Hardy nil-orbit (horizontal triple + ergodic transfer for the discontinuous bracket observable), with all fixed-harmonic empirics at square-root scale. 1 Sep 2026 (J-horizontal-leftover-exponents): the horizontal Weyl sums S_k are first-level monomials in m = floor(n^{3/2}) with leftover alphas {-3/8, 3/4, 15/8}, all strictly below the 9/4 engine line; they are NOT a Theorem R corollary (different kernel, and 3/4 is an excluded special value of the withdrawn Corollary R'). The horizontal half of the nil-route is PARKED as write-up work, not upgraded to a theorem. The remaining open of the rate-free target is still the ergodic transfer, now including the Heisenberg vertical.
